name: Tianlu Wang
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Recent soft-robotics AP with a verified neural-perception-to-physical-navigation contribution. Useful software/perception project potential, although the broader lab emphasizes mechanics, fabrication and small-scale actuation rather than general-purpose robot learning.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full 2025 Synthetic Data-Assisted Miniature Medical Robot Navigation via Ultrasound Imaging paper trains YOLOv5s with synthetic and real ultrasound data. CNN detections drive a real Franka-mounted probe and stop/search/resume magnetic actuation of a stentbot along pre-scanned lumens. Joystick commands still specify direction; low-level control is classical. Navigation is demonstrated in tissue-mimicking phantoms, while separate detection tests use ex-vivo tissue. This is a joint MPI/ETH/Hawaiʻi study, not verified current Hawaiʻi apparatus or clinical deployment.

shortVisit.status: inquiry-only · live exchange/intern line with 2024-era context
shortVisit.summary: The live SAIL opportunities page explicitly lists research assistant, exchange-student and intern positions separately from PhD positions. However, the surrounding dated PhD call begins Fall 2024, and the page does not independently confirm 2027 capacity. Research assistant inquiries request a CV, representative article and research interests. No outside-master acceptance, summer duration, stipend or remote option is promised.
